ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 v_temp number;
 v_where varchar2(200);
begin
 go_block('valid_territories');

 if :ctrl_blk_1.chk_term='N' then
 v_where:=' territory_short_name=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_terri_short_name,territory_short_name) and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and term_date is null';
 set_block_property('valid_territories',default_where,v_where);
 else
 v_where:=' territory_short_name=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_terri_short_name,territory_short_name) and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id';
 set_block_property('valid_territories',default_where,v_where);
 end if;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_terri_short_name is not null then
 select nvl(count(*), 0) 
 into v_temp 
 from valid_territories 
 where territory_short_name = :ctrl_blk_1.s_terri_short_name
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- Added by Kishore on 03/23/2012. IM 7679
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 03/23/2012. IM 7679;
 if v_temp > 0 then
 execute_query;
 enable_disable('D'); 
 else
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_terri_short_name');
 show_error('11017');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 ELSE
 go_block('valid_territories');
 execute_query;
 enable_disable('D'); 
 END IF;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 
/* Check in the database */


 If nvl(:global.short_name,' ') != nvl(:valid_territories.territory_short_name,' ') then
 select nvl(count(*),0) into temp from valid_territories where
 territory_short_name= :valid_territories.territory_short_name;

 if temp > 0 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

/* check in the buffer */

 if nvl(:global.short_name,' ') != nvl(:valid_territories.territory_short_name,' ') then
 check_insert_rg('terri_rg0','C10',:global.short_name||',','D',check_dup); 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('terri_rg0','C10',:valid_territories.territory_short_name||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('terri_rg0','C10',:valid_territories.territory_short_name||',','U',check_dup);
 end if;
END;
